items.work: Plaster patching to an internal wall, per m²
items.source: Typical BCIS domestic rate for small patch repair. Realistic call-out charge (plasterer_decorator minimum £250–300) assumes multiple m² in one visit.
items.notes: Do not use directly for pricing — too low for realistic visit charges. Use plasterer_decorator minimum floor instead.

items.work: Emulsion paint, internal wall redecoration, per m²
items.source: Typical BCIS domestic rate for redecorating a painted surface. Per-m² rate does not capture setup, access, surface prep time.
items.notes: Reference only. SiteSnap uses call-out minimums instead.

items.work: Bath/shower sealant renewal, per linear metre
items.source: Typical BCIS domestic rate for sealant removal and replacement. Does not include fixtures or grouting.
items.notes: Reference only. Plumber call-out minimum £200–250 is a more realistic floor for this work.
